report_datetime.description: Date and time the report was generated, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

subject_name.description: Full name of the sanctioned subject, as printed in the report heading.

listing.description: The sanctions list entry the subject appears on.

entity_type.description: Type of listed entity, e.g. Individual, Entity, Vessel.

list_name.description: Name of the sanctions list, e.g. SDN (OFAC).

programs.description: Every sanctions program the listing falls under.

date_of_publication.description: Date of publication of the listing, as YYYY-MM-DD.

remark.description: The listing's remark, in full, as printed.

names.description: Every name and alias listed for the subject, in the order printed.

alias_quality.description: Alias quality, Weak or Strong. Empty string for the primary name.

has_historical_records.description: True if the Historical data section lists any records.

sanctions_data_updated.description: When the sanctions list data for this subject was last updated, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

source_change_check.description: When the report last checked the original source for changes, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

lists_checked.description: Every sanctions list the service includes, with the date its latest changes were published.

list.description: Name of the list or issuing authority.

latest_change_date.description: Date the list's latest changes were published, as YYYY-MM-DD.
